title: Active plasma lens focusing of laser-accelerated proton beams
abstract: We measure the focusing strength and aberrations of an active plasma lens for a laser-driven proton beam transport line.

title: Discharge capillary plasma channel characterization
abstract: Interferometry and spectroscopy resolve the density evolution and stability of a discharged capillary used as a plasma channel.

title: Bunch plasma wakefield effects in a compact beamline
abstract: A particle bunch excites a wakefield in a plasma channel and the resulting transverse forces are evaluated for beam transport and diagnostics.

title: Ablation plasma diagnostics for laser-solid interaction
abstract: Optical emission and interferometry diagnose the density and temperature of an ablation plasma created by an intense laser pulse.

title: FLASH radiation hydrodynamics for laser target interaction
abstract: The FLASH hydrodynamics code is used to model laser-driven target expansion and compare synthetic diagnostics with experiment.

title: Plastic scintillator detector for laser-driven ion beams
abstract: A plastic scintillator detector measures the energy and dose of ions produced by a laser-driven target.

title: Deformable mirror control for a high-power laser beamline
abstract: Wavefront correction with a deformable mirror improves the focal spot in a laser-driven particle experiment.

title: Post-acceleration of laser-driven ions with a plasma lens
abstract: Protons gain additional energy after the main target through a compact plasma-based focusing and acceleration stage.

title: PIC simulation of laser-ion interaction and Coulomb fields
abstract: Particle-in-cell simulations resolve ion acceleration, space-charge evolution, and the Coulomb field around a structured target.

title: Electromagnetic pulse generation in laser-solid interaction
abstract: The temporal structure and mitigation of EMP generated during intense laser-solid interaction are measured on a laser accelerator target chamber.

title: Emittance measurement in a conventional synchrotron beamline
abstract: A transverse emittance monitor is calibrated and optimized for a storage-ring diagnostic beamline without a laser-driven source.

title: Generic plasma wave propagation in a laboratory discharge
abstract: The dispersion of waves in a low-temperature laboratory plasma is studied without a laser-target interaction or accelerator beam application.

title: Plasma diagnostics for a tokamak divertor
abstract: We measure edge turbulence and impurity transport in a magnetic-confinement fusion device.

title: Plastic scintillator imaging for clinical radiotherapy
abstract: A plastic scintillator detector is developed for quality assurance in a hospital photon radiotherapy beam.
